story.originalTitle: How the 2027 F1 grid is shaping up after Max Verstappen's Red Bull renewal
story.summaryEn: Three 2027 driver announcements emerged in the same week after the summer break, but all were contract renewals rather than moves, including Max Verstappen's extension with Red Bull. The 2027 grid is gradually taking shape as the driver market's 'silly season' gives way to a more sensible one.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛续约后，2027年F1车手阵容如何成型
明年的车手阵容正逐渐明朗——但谁会为哪支车队效力？
乍一看，同一周内出现三份2027年车手官宣，似乎表明随着赛季从夏休中恢复，F1的“疯狂签约季”已经隆重拉开帷幕。
然而，这三份官宣都是合同续签。这并不是疯狂签约季——而是理性签约季，而且在未来几个月里，看到更多续约消息通过全球媒体平台传播，也完全不会令人意外。亚历克斯·阿尔本、卡洛斯·塞恩斯，以及现在的马克斯·维斯塔潘都选择了按兵不动，这应该会开始推动今年车手市场上更多多米诺骨牌的倒下。
这并不是说关于疯狂猜测的希望已经结束。明年仍然有很多空余席位，而且预计车手顺序还会有一些调整，即使这或许不是某些人所希望的整个车手阵容的大洗牌。
无论如何，2027年的车手阵容正开始逐渐明朗。来看看目前的情况。
梅赛德斯：安东内利、拉塞尔
梅赛德斯同时管理着Russell和Antonelli——并且已将两人都签约至2027年
众所周知，梅赛德斯明年的车手阵容不会有进一步变动——而且它也不需要任何变动。
尽管基米·安东内利（安东内利）成为今年夺冠热门对许多人来说有些意外——至少从某种意义上说，这只是他的第二个赛季——但梅赛德斯的立场是，这位意大利车手的表现与车队当初把他从卡丁车界招入青训计划时的预期一致。安东内利的成功让队友乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）黯然失色，但这位英国车手尚未出局，仍然有机会争夺今年的冠军头衔。
法拉利：夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）、刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）
法拉利对其勒克莱尔-汉密尔顿的组合感到满意。
法拉利今年早些时候与勒克莱尔达成了一项新协议，并于六月初对外公布，这位摩纳哥车手将继续与跃马保持长期合作，合同为多年期。随着法拉利在2026年表现提升，Leclerc希望车队能够再接再厉，最终打造出一辆符合他的天赋和全力以赴风格的冠军赛车。
汉密尔顿在本赛季早些时候提到，他明年也有合同在身。从他在2026年迄今的表现来看，留在法拉利完全是应得的；焕发新生的Hamilton目前位居车手积分榜第二，落后Antonelli 50分。
一个快乐大家庭？显然，Piastri并没有离开迈凯伦的危险……
迈凯伦的两名车手都有明年的合同，尽管众所周知Verstappen曾与车队进行过某种程度的接触——即便这可能只是为了在与红牛谈判时争取更丰厚合同而摆出的姿态。当时的说法是，如果Verstappen要与Gianpiero Lambiase和Rob Marshall等人重聚，皮亚斯特里可能会转向别处——但Piastri的经理人Mark Webber几周前否定了这位澳大利亚车手离开车队的可能性。
与此同时，诺里斯 似乎满足于暂时继续做一名单一车队车手。他的表现也非常惊艳，所以迈凯伦想要留住这位卫冕冠军也在情理之中。
在锁定 Verstappen 之后，红牛看起来将在'27赛季保留其完整车手阵容。
既然 Verstappen 已经签约至少到2030年，红牛还需要敲定第二辆赛车的车手。这应该只是走个形式，因为 哈贾尔 本赛季表现出色，在排位赛中甚至给这位荷兰人制造了不小的压力——即便两人在比赛节奏上存在些许差距。
Hadjar 因手腕骨折缺席荷兰大奖赛，他将密切关注 劳森 作为替补重返红牛阵营的情况。不过，这位法国车手不必担心自己在车队中的位置——除非 Lawson 有什么真正惊艳的表现……
小红牛（ 比赛 公牛车队）：是 劳森、Arvid Lindblad，还是 Nikola Tsolov？
Tsolov 有可能明年就驾驶 VCARB 完成他的 F1 首秀吗？
通往不确定性的走廊上的第一个正经停靠点是 小红牛 车队，他们可能面临一个“三人争两席”的难题。Lawson 本赛季表现出色，为这支意大利车队很好地担起了领头羊的角色，而 Arvid Lindblad 也确实证明了自己作为未来之星的资质，他在新秀赛季中展现出理智且难能可贵的自我批评态度。

如果红牛的青训阶梯上缺乏人才，那么这两人稳留原位是板上钉钉的事，但 F2 积分榜领跑者 Nikola Tsolov 正在力争锁定明年车队的一个正式席位。Tsolov 有志于成为首位保加利亚籍 F1 车手，他展现出了相当可观的速度，并且他在银石两场比赛中的胜利是一次罕见的“正赛+冲刺赛”双料包揽。唯一的美中不足是他偶尔会做出过于激进的操作——正如他在匈牙利与 Sebastian Montoya 的碰撞所展示的那样，那次事故让他在亨格罗林冲刺赛中损失了不可忽视的积分。
Lawson 将力争把这次重返 红牛 作为跳板，留在 小红牛，或者如果 Tsolov 和 Lindblad 获得青睐，甚至谋求其他车队的席位。
Colapinto 需要继续给 Briatore 留下深刻印象，才能留在 阿尔派
加斯利 去年与 阿尔派 续签了合同，尽管车队在整个2025赛季在车队积分榜末尾徘徊，他仍展现了对事业的承诺。随着 Flavio Briatore、Steve Nielsen 和梅赛德斯的加入，车队已重回中游争夺，这位法国车手希望 Enstone 车队能打造出一辆配得上他巨大——且常被低估——天赋的赛车。
与此同时，科拉平托 今年在表现上迈出了相当大的一步，并偶尔超越 Gasly。他在迈阿密和加拿大的表现证明这位阿根廷车手配得上他在F1中的位置，但需要在排位赛中找到更高的一致性，以减少那些默默无闻的下午的数量。如果 Colapinto 无法保住席位，阿尔派 青训车手 Paul Aron 和 Gabriele Mini 将是这里的选择。
Bearman将留在哈斯——但谁会加入他呢？
随着法拉利车手阵容敲定，贝尔曼看起来将在哈斯迎来第三个完整赛季。这位英国车手在2026赛季开局表现亮眼，但随着车队走下坡路，这种状态已经消退。由于受到一些质量控制问题的困扰，以及在研发周期中收益不尽如人意，哈斯急需一剂强心针来保住车队积分榜第七的位置。

奥康在车队中的位置存在疑问，这很遗憾，因为这位法国车手显然是一位有实力的车手。问题在于，到目前为止，转投哈斯对他来说并没有真正奏效，而且车队一直在通过TPC测试考察几位车手，以潜在地寻找接班人。现任储备车手Ryo Hirakawa、F2卫冕冠军兼迈凯伦青训车手Leonardo Fornaroli，以及法拉利新星Rafael Camara都在名单之上。角田裕毅也被认为是一个人选，但这位日本车手同时在就加盟Meyer Shank的IndyCar赛事进行谈判。
奥迪：博托莱托、霍肯伯格
实力强劲的博尔托莱托-霍肯伯格组合确保了奥迪不存在车手方面的问题
尽管一些媒体曾将塞恩斯与奥迪联系在一起，但他选择留在威廉姆斯的决定至少表明这支瑞士-德国车队的人选已定。博尔托莱托表示他签有长期合同，并期待留在车队，而据了解霍肯伯格也将留在车队至2027年。
无论如何，奥迪都没有理由更换其车手阵容；它拥有年轻与经验的完美结合，而且两位队友之间关系融洽。
塞恩斯延长了与威廉姆斯的合同，使车队2027年的车手阵容保持不变
威廉姆斯车队决定至少再锁定一年阿尔本（Albon）和塞恩斯（Sainz），这表明两位车手都认可车队的长期雄心，尽管今年的成绩有所退步。有些人可能会不客气地说，这两位车手其实也没有其他地方可去，这或许也是事实，但保留这两位车手对车队来说是一个重大利好。
据说，如果塞恩斯（Sainz）当初决定去做别的选择，威廉姆斯也留了后手，曾与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯（Sergio Perez）和科拉平托（Colapinto）的管理团队商谈2027年的事宜，而卢克·布朗宁（Luke Browning）在代表车队参加的几次一练（FP1）中的表现也令人印象深刻。
阿斯顿·马丁（阿斯顿·马丁）：费尔南多·阿隆索（阿隆索）、兰斯·斯特罗尔（斯特罗尔）？
阿隆索谈论自己的未来——他会留在阿斯顿·马丁吗？
detailEn: How the 2027 F1 grid is shaping up after Max Verstappen's Red Bull renewal
Next year's grid is starting to fall into place - but who's driving where?

On the face of it, the emergence of three 2027 driver announcements in the same week might suggest that Formula 1's silly season had truly kicked off in style as the season emerged from its summer hibernation.

All three, however, were announcements of contract renewals. This isn't silly season - this is sensible season, and it wouldn't be wholly surprising to see news of a few more contract extensions disseminate across worldwide media platforms over the next few months. Alex Albon, Carlos Sainz, and now Max Verstappen have chosen to hold position, which should start to precipitate the fall of a few more dominoes in this year's driver market.

That's not to say that the hopes of silliness are over. There's still plenty of open seats for next year and expectations of a few shuffles in the order, even if it's not the wholesale changes around the grid that perhaps some were hoping for.
Either way, 2027's grid is starting to fall into place. Here's a look at the situation so far.
Mercedes: Kimi Antonelli, George Russell
Mercedes manages both Russell and Antonelli - and has both tied up for '27
It's been known for quite some time that Mercedes will make no further changes to its line-up for next year - and nor does it need them.

While Kimi Antonelli's emergence as this year's title favourite will have come as some surprise to many, at least in the sense that this is only his second season, Mercedes would argue that the Italian's performances have been as forecast when it plucked him from karting and into its junior programme. Antonelli's successes have put team-mate George Russell in the shade, but the Briton is not down-and-out just yet and retains a chance of securing this year's title.
Ferrari: Charles Leclerc, Lewis Hamilton
Ferrari is happy with its Leclerc-Hamilton pairing

Ferrari agreed a new deal with Charles Leclerc earlier this year, communicated at the start of June, as the Monegasque continues his lengthy association with the Prancing Horse on a continued multi-year basis. With Ferrari's improved performances in 2026, Leclerc's hope is that the team can press on and at last deliver a championship-winning car that chimes with his flair and all-in approach.

Lewis Hamilton mentioned earlier in the season that he too is under contract for next year. On the evidence of his performances so far over 2026, a stay at Ferrari would be much deserved; a revitalised Hamilton is second in the championship, and 50 points away from Antonelli.
One happy family? Piastri was, apparently, in no danger of leaving McLaren...

Both of McLaren's drivers have contracts for next year, although it was known that Verstappen had held some level of talks with the team - even if this was simply posturing to secure a more lucrative deal with Red Bull. The suggestion was that if Verstappen was to reunite with the likes of Gianpiero Lambiase and Rob Marshall, Oscar Piastri would potentially go the other way - but Piastri's manager Mark Webber shut down the idea of the Australian leaving the team a few weeks ago.
Lando Norris, meanwhile, seems content to remain a one-team man for the time being. He's been mightily impressive too, so it makes sense that McLaren would want to keep hold of the reigning champion.
Red Bull looks set to retain its full line-up for '27 after locking Verstappen down

Now that Verstappen is on board until at least 2030, Red Bull has its second car to sort out. This should be a mere formality, as Isack Hadjar has impressed this season and has given the Dutchman a run for his money in qualifying - even if there's a slight race-pace disparity between them.

Hadjar, out for the Dutch Grand Prix after fracturing a wrist, will keep a keen eye on Liam Lawson's return to the Red Bull fold as a substitute. However, the Frenchman shouldn't need to worry about his place in the team - unless Lawson does something really spectacular...
Racing Bulls: Liam Lawson, Arvid Lindblad, or Nikola Tsolov?
Could Tsolov make his F1 debut next year in a VCARB?

The first proper stop into the corridor of uncertainty lies at Racing Bulls, which may have a three-into-two-won't-go conundrum to solve. Lawson has been excellent this season and has led the line admirably for the Italian squad, while Arvid Lindblad has certainly demonstrated his credentials as a star of the future with a sensible and refreshingly self-critical approach to his rookie year.

If Red Bull's junior staircase was devoid of talent then the two would be a shoo-in to stay, but F2 championship leader Nikola Tsolov is angling to secure one of the drives for next year. Aiming to become F1's first Bulgarian driver, Tsolov has demonstrated considerable speed and his victories in both Silverstone races was a rare feature-sprint roll-over. The only hair in the soup is his occasional propensity for overly ambitious manoeuvres - as demonstrated by his clash with Sebastian Montoya in Hungary, which cost a not-insignificant points haul from the Hungaroring sprint.
Lawson will aim to use his Red Bull return as a springboard to stay with Racing Bulls, or even angle for a drive elsewhere if Tsolov and Lindblad get the nod.
Colapinto needs to keep impressing Briatore to stay at Alpine

Pierre Gasly signed a contract extension with Alpine last year, demonstrating his commitment to the cause despite the team being adrift at the back of the constructors' order across 2025. The arrival of Flavio Briatore, Steve Nielsen, and Mercedes has put the team back into the midfield battle, and the Frenchman is hoping that the Enstone squad can deliver a car worthy of his immense - and oft-underrated - talent.

Franco Colapinto, meanwhile, has made a considerable step in performance this year and has occasionally bested Gasly. His performances in Miami and Canada demonstrated that the Argentine is worthy of his place in F1, but needs to find greater consistency in qualifying to reduce the quantity of anonymous afternoons. Were Colapinto not to retain his place, Alpine juniors Paul Aron and Gabriele Mini would be options here.
Bearman will stay at Haas - but who will join him?

With Ferrari's line-up locked in, Oliver Bearman looks set for a third full year with Haas. The Briton had an impressive start to 2026, although that form has waned as the team has gone backwards. Plagued by a handful of quality control issues and less-than-ideal gains through its development cycle, Haas is in dire need of a pick-me-up to retain seventh in the constructors' standings.

There are doubts about Esteban Ocon's place at the team, which is a shame as the Frenchman is clearly a quality driver. The problem is that, so far, the Haas move hasn't really worked for him, and the team has been cycling through a few drivers in its TPC testing to potentially identify a successor. Current reserve Ryo Hirakawa, reigning F2 champion and McLaren junior Leonardo Fornaroli, and Ferrari youngster Rafael Camara are on the list. Yuki Tsunoda was also suggested as an option, but the Japanese driver is also in talks over an IndyCar drive with Meyer Shank.
Audi: Gabriel Bortoleto, Nico Hulkenberg
The potent Bortoleto-Hulkenberg pairing ensures Audi does not have a driver problem on its hands

Although Sainz was linked with Audi by some outlets, his decision to stay at Williams at least suggests that the Swiss-German team is spoken for. Bortoleto says that he's got a long-term deal in place and is expecting to stay at the team, while Hulkenberg is also understood to be in place for 2027.
There would be no reason for Audi to change its line-up, in any case; it has the perfect blend of youth and experience, and a harmonious relationship between its two team-mates.
Sainz extended his Williams deal to keep its line-up static for '27

Williams' decision to lock in Albon and Sainz for at least another year demonstrates the buy-in for its long-term ambitions from both drivers, even if this year has presented a step back in fortunes. Some might uncharitably suggest that there was nowhere else for either driver to go, which is probably also true, but the retention of both drivers is a significant boost for the team.

Had Sainz decided to do something else, Williams is said to have hedged its bets and had spoken to the management of Sergio Perez and Colapinto for 2027, while Luke Browning has also impressed in his FP1 outings with the team.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."

relatedItems.originalTitle: Why Cadillac F1 boss provoked fresh intrigue by dodging driver question
detailZh: 为什么凯迪拉克F1负责人通过回避车手问题引发新的好奇
关于瓦尔特里·博塔斯在凯迪拉克未来去向的猜测持续存在，因为车队正打算引入一名美国车手
马辛·布德科夫斯基，凯迪拉克车队负责人
美国大奖赛周末自然意味着聚光灯转向了F1的两支美国车队。这也导致凯迪拉克在对其2027年及以后车手阵容的猜测中面临了一些尴尬的问题。
Sergio Perez和Valtteri Bottas都签订了“多年”合同，据说是所谓的“一年加一年”安排，其中第二年是否续约是可选的，取决于双方满足各种条件。两位车手之间的表现差异如此之大，以至于Bottas的位置已经成为了几个月来车队的八卦话题。
最近任命的团队负责人Marcin Budkowski已经不得不对此进行一些灭火工作，他的前任Graeme Lowdon也是如此。但周五在奥斯汀举行的FIA车队代表新闻发布会上的一个相当奇特的时刻表明，凯迪拉克的计划并不像之前宣传的那样固定。
引发这一事件的催化剂是来自一位广播员的关于Perez即将迎来第300场大奖赛起跑的软问题：“评价一个在网格后部战斗的车手有多难，同时他给人的印象是比队友有更好的赛季表现？关于车手，你们有兴趣就也许的预备角色与Esteban [奥康]进行任何对话吗？”
在试图给出一个合适的含糊其辞的答案时，Budkowski开始感到困惑。
“看，对于一个像Checo这样的车手，正如你所说，他有着丰富的经验和许多比赛，我可以告诉你，他并不像任何接近退休的车手那样表现或驾驶，”他说。
“他在驾驶座上非常努力。他在幕后也非常努力地推动我们，在简报室和外面，他经常给我和其他团队成员发短信，推动我们进步。他渴望胜利，他充满动力，这实际上是非常好的。他以自己的风格做到这一点。
“我们有两名车手：一个可能更热情，另一个可能更冷静，如果我们可以这样说的。他们都以自己独特的方式推动车队，但Checo确实是在非常努力地推动我们。仅从他在起跑线上的身体语言来看，当他戴上头盔，坐进车里，他正在为战斗做准备。那里充满了激情，充满了动力，对于一个经验丰富的车手来说，这确实是非常令人印象深刻的。
“同时，我们也在从他的反馈和作为一名经验丰富的车手的角度获取他的意见。所以，是的，这是一个非常好的组合。
“很抱歉，第二个问题是关于埃斯特班·奥康的？嗯，看吧，作为一个车队负责人，我相信我的同事也是一样，你会接到来自市场上每一位车手或车手经理的电话和联系。所以，有很多车手和经理已经联系了我。
“我不会说是谁或不是谁，但几乎所有在市场上的人都已经联系过了，正如你所预期的。但是，是的，我想这是最后一个地方，正如你可以想象的那样，我不会在这里传达任何关于车手阵容的信息。
如果威廉·莎士比亚在场，毫无疑问他会拿起羽毛笔在羊皮纸上划掉一条笔记，表示这位绅士过于抗议。幸运的是，对于凯迪拉克车队负责人来说，也许，阿德里安·纽维在场，并成为了后续大多数问题的自然磁铁。
Motorsport.com了解到，奥康几乎不可能加入凯迪拉克，因为他和佩雷斯在上一次同处一室时就像油和水一样不相容。据信他可能会成为阿斯顿·马丁的第三位车手。
凯迪拉克是否会在2027年保留博塔斯，目前尚不清楚，但众所周知，车队老板希望尽快有一位美国车手坐在赛车座位上。洛夫顿今年夏天的意外替代者表明，通用汽车和TWG赛车运动公司的期望似乎领先于车队目前的进展。
凯迪拉克在美洲赛车场的自由练习1中使用了科尔顿·赫塔，但他由于国际汽联改变了资格赛规则，只差一分未能获得超级驾照，因此他成为任何比赛机会的左翼候选人。如果他今年在其他练习中能有有意义的驾驶表现，他将获得资格——但他在本赛季的F2赛事表现相当不稳定，并不是一张很强的名片。
“显然，在美国车队中有美国车手是一个很好的故事，”布德科维茨在本周末对天空体育说。
“这需要是正确的时间和正确的车手。但我们正在努力。我们正在和科尔顿一起努力。
“有一些真正令人兴奋的美国新秀正在崛起。我们看到了Ugo Ugochukwu赢得了F3冠军。我们还有Sebastian Wheldon将在明年进入F3。”
““所以这里有很多潜力，我们当然会去调查。”"
detailEn: Why Cadillac F1 boss provoked fresh intrigue by dodging driver question
Speculation continues to surround the future of Valtteri Bottas at Cadillac as the team looks to bring on an American driver
Marcin Budkowski, Cadillac Team Principal

The US GP weekend naturally means the spotlight gravitates towards Formula 1’s two American-owned teams. That has led to some awkward questions for Cadillac amid ongoing speculation over its driver line-up for 2027 and beyond.

Both Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas are on “multi-year” contracts, understood to be a so-called one-plus-one arrangement in which the second year is optional, subject to either party fulfilling various conditions. Such has been the disparity in performance between the two drivers that Bottas’s position has been the object of paddock gossip for months.

Recently appointed team principal Marcin Budkowski has already had to do some firefighting on this, as had his predecessor Graeme Lowdon. But a rather peculiar moment in the FIA’s press conference for team representatives on Friday in Austin suggested Cadillac’s plans aren’t as fixed as previously billed.

The catalyst was a soft question from one of the broadcasters on the theme of Perez’s upcoming 300th grand prix start: “How difficult is it to evaluate a driver who’s fighting at the back of the grid, at the same time as the impression is that he’s having a better season than his team-mate? And quickly on drivers, would you be interested in having any conversation with Esteban [Ocon] regarding maybe a reserve role?”
In trying to give a suitably anodyne non-answer, Budkowski began to flounder.

“Look, for a driver like Checo, who, as you said, has a huge amount of experience and a number of races, I can tell you he doesn’t behave or drive like a driver who is anywhere close to retirement,” hew said.

“He’s pushing very hard behind the wheel. He’s pushing us very hard also behind the scenes, in the debrief rooms and outside, and regularly texting me and other members of the team to push us to improve. He’s hungry, he’s motivated, and that’s actually really good to see. He does it in his own style.

“We have two drivers: one is more hot and one is probably more cold, if we could say, from there. And they both push the team in their own particular ways, but Checo is, yes, pushing us very hard. And just looking at the way his body language on the grid, when he gets his helmet on and he gets in the car, he’s getting ready for a fight. There’s a lot of fire, there’s a lot of motivation there, so it’s really impressive for a driver of this experience.
“And at the same time, we’re getting his feedback and his input in terms of, as an experienced driver. So yes, it’s a very good combination.

“And sorry, the second question was about Esteban Ocon? Well, look, as a team principal, and I’m sure it’s the same with my colleagues, you’re getting calls and contacts from every driver or driver manager that is on the market. So, there are a number of drivers and managers who have contacted me.

“I’m not going to say who it is or who it isn’t, but pretty much all of them that are on the market have been in touch, as you’d expect. But yes, I think it’s the last place here, as you can imagine, where I would communicate anything on driver line-up.”

Were William Shakespeare present, he would no doubt have put quill to parchment and scratched out a note to the effect that the gentleman doth protest too much. Fortunately for the Cadillac team principal, perhaps, Adrian Newey was in the room and acted as a natural magnet for the majority of further questions.

Motorsport.com understands that Ocon is highly unlikely to go to Cadillac, since he and Perez mixed like oil and water when they last coexisted under the same roof. It’s believed he will probably become Aston Martin’s third driver.

Whether or not Cadillac retain Bottas for 2027, it’s known that the team’s owners wish to have an American driver in a race seat as soon as possible. Lowdon’s surprise replacement this summer is an indication of how General Motors and TWG Motorsports’ expectations appear to be running somewhere ahead of the team’s current progress.

Cadillac ran Colton Herta in FP1 at the Circuit of The Americas, but he is a leftfield candidate for any race opportunities since he is one point short of qualifying for a superlicence, owing to the FIA having changed the qualifying rubric. If he has meaningful running in another session this year he will qualify – but his rather patchy Formula 2 campaign this season isn’t a very strong calling card.
“Obviously having an American driver in an American team is a great story,” Budkowski told Sky Sports this weekend.
“It needs to be the right time and the right driver. But we're working on that. We're working on that with Colton.
“There are some really exciting American talents coming up through the ranks as well. We've seen Ugo Ugochukwu winning F3. We've got [Sebastian] Wheldon coming through to F3 next year.
“So there's a lot of potential here and we'll look into that obviously.”
